summary: Decomposition of the US$3T question into 13 research questions (RQ-01..RQ-13): seven are arithmetic-critical (base nominal GDP in NPR, matching NPR/USD averages, deflator history, real growth history, population, defensible FX/deflator paths, FY/CY reconciliation) and six concern feasibility (investment/ICOR, external and fiscal room, historical growth-spell frequency, binding constraints, and the conditions synthesis). A dependency-ordered task set (P1-00 .. P7-01) is given per roadmap phase with hard/soft edges and one objective acceptance criterion per task. The minimal path to close the US$3T ARITHMETIC runs only through Phase 2 data tasks and Phase 3 tasks P3-01..P3-07; the catalog graph currently delays it behind the full global wave (01C in batch 15), which is flagged for human review. All empirical inputs remain PENDING: data hosts were unreachable in round r1 and no values are reported.

findings.claim: The US$3T arithmetic reduces to the identity nominal USD GDP = nominal NPR GDP / NPR-per-USD, projected with separate real-growth, deflator and exchange-rate paths; it can be evaluated once RQ-01..RQ-06 and RQ-09 are answered, independently of the feasibility questions RQ-08 and RQ-10..RQ-13.
findings.note: Decomposition design choice consistent with CLAUDE.md rule 6 and config/model_config.yaml conventions.

findings.claim: Base-year nominal GDP (NPR, current prices), its fiscal year and revision status
findings.note: Required: NSO National Accounts latest release; data host unreachable in r1. Owner 01A/01C; task P2-02.

findings.claim: NPR/USD fiscal-year and calendar-year period averages matching the base year
findings.note: Required: NRB exchange-rate statistics; WDI PA.NUS.FCRF as cross-check. Task P2-03.
Required: Census 2021 national report, NSO projections, UN WPP latest revision. Task P2-04.

findings.claim: The catalog dependency graph places 01C (US$3T arithmetic owner) in batch 15 of 18 in state/plan.md, although the arithmetic's inputs are Phase-2 data tasks; the minimal path P2-01 -> P2-02/03/04/07 -> P2-08 -> P2-09 -> P2-10 -> P3-01..P3-07 has no dependency on the global research wave.
findings.note: Structural observation from config/subagents.json and state/plan.md (platform records, no empirical value). Proposed remedy requires a catalog change and human review; not made here.

findings.claim: Every task in specific.task_list is closed by an objective, checkable criterion in specific.acceptance_criteria (a command, ledger state, identity check or recomputation).

data_gaps: All 26 baseline requirements in reports/baseline/baseline_report.md (no values retrieved in r1).
Constant-price base year and rebasing/back-cast method of NSO national accounts (needed for consistent real-growth history).
Research-question-level evidence for RQ-08, RQ-10..RQ-12 (PWT, Maddison, NEA, MoF/OAG, PDMO).
Observation store research/sources/observations.jsonl does not yet exist.

assumptions.text: The US$3T target is annual nominal GDP in current US dollars (config/model_config.yaml target.measure); per-capita and PPP measures are reported separately and never substituted.
Arithmetic and feasibility are decomposed separately: the arithmetic can be closed and audited before feasibility evidence exists; feasibility statements require both.

'Minimal' task set = the smallest set of tasks whose outputs are inputs to the phase deliverable in docs/implementation/roadmap_status.md; subagents not on that set still run per state/plan.md but do not gate the phase.
Data-only task variants (P2-02, P2-03, P2-04, P2-06) are proposals; until the catalog is changed with human review, they execute within the existing subagents' schedules.

challenges.text: Record explicitly which FX average (FY vs CY) is paired with which GDP period in every USD conversion; the headline target year crossing depends on it (see 00B-r1 C-01/C-02).
State the constant-price base year and whether the real series is spliced across rebasings; unspliced series break RQ-04.
Keep census de jure/absent-population concepts separate from WPP mid-year estimates; do not merge them into one population path.
Please treat AC-P2-02 identity checks and AC-P3-06 reproduction as preconditions for any VERIFIED verdict on TGT-ARITH.

uncertainty: The decomposition is structural and carries no empirical values, so its main uncertainty is completeness: feasibility questions may surface further constraints (e.g. land, urbanisation, institutional capacity) that add tasks in later rounds. Scheduling uncertainty is large: whether the arithmetic closes early depends on a human decision about catalog data-only variants and on network access to NSO/NRB hosts. No source leads could be fetched in r1; all lead URLs are catalog-level and unverified.

research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.question: What is the latest official nominal GDP at current prices in NPR, for which fiscal year, and with what revision status and constant-price base year?
research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.data_required: NSO National Accounts annual release (latest), all FYs FY2000/01-latest

research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.question: What NPR/USD period average (FY and CY) applies to that GDP period, and how is it computed?
What is the history of the implicit GDP deflator and how does it relate to CPI and Indian inflation under the peg?
research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.data_required: NSO deflator series; NRB CPI; Indian official price indices

research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.question: What is the history and volatility of real GDP growth on a consistent base?
research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.data_required: NSO constant-price GDP incl. back-cast across rebasings

research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.question: What is the base population and its projection by variant (needed for per-capita interpretation and labour supply)?
research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.data_required: Census 2021; NSO projections; UN WPP variants

research_questions_before_US3T_evaluatio.question: What long-run NPR/USD and deflator paths are defensible given the NPR-INR peg and INR/USD history?
What real growth is required to reach US$3T by 2050/2060/2070 under each price/FX case on the verified base?
What investment rate, ICOR and labour-input growth would the required real growth imply, versus history?
How are fiscal-year and calendar-year series reconciled, and do official and international cross-check series agree after reconciliation?
What external-financing, fiscal and debt room exists (remittances, BoP, reserves, public debt)?
How often have comparable economies sustained the required growth for the required duration, and under which preconditions?
Which physical and institutional constraints bind (electricity, capex execution, logistics, climate damage)?
Under which explicit conditions is US$3T attainable or unattainable by each milestone, and at what cost to the other 11 objectives?
